decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location plan, statement, 1395 09, 1395 08, 1395 06, 1395 05, 1395 04, 1395 03, 1395 02 received on 26/10/2014; 1409-845-104 Rev A and 1409-845-106 Rev A received on 10/12/14 and email from agent dated 12/12/14) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building except where specified in an email from the agent dated 12th December 2014.
description: Reinstatement works to high level structures and roof following fire damage and internal refurbishment
